data.one_liner: A Flutter widget to display text with furigana ruby annotations.
data.what_it_does: Provides a RubyText widget and RubyTextData models to render text accompanied by smaller ruby text annotations, typically used for furigana in Japanese. Supports custom text styles, spacing, overflow, and alignment.
use_when: You need to display Japanese furigana or similar phonetic annotations above base text.
You want a dedicated widget for rendering ruby text inline with standard Flutter text properties.
avoid_when: You only need standard plain text without ruby annotations.
You require complex interactive features attached to individual ruby spans.
strengths: Easy to use API with RubyText and RubyTextData.
Supports performance caching introduced in recent versions.
Cross-platform support including Android, iOS, web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
weaknesses: onTap functionality was removed in version 3.0.0.
Limited to furigana-style ruby text rendering.
